message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity (approx.) |
|----------|------|--------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried lasagna noodles | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | Sugar (optional, to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 tbsp (56 g) |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 tbsp (30 g) |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Mozzarella cheese, shredded | 8 oz (225 g) |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Egg (for binding ricotta) | 1 |
| | Parsley or basil, chopped | 1 tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |

**Optional extras**

- Spinach or other leafy greens (sautéed, ~2 cups)
- Mushrooms (sliced, sautéed, ~1 cup)
- Bell peppers (diced, sautéed, ~1 cup)

These ingredients will give you a hearty, layered lasagna with a rich meat sauce, creamy béchamel, and melty cheeses. Enjoy cooking!
